# E0206: import cycle

Modules can't import one another in a cycle. Move what both need into a third module, which each imports.

- Rule: [`program.no-cycles`](../../reference/04-programs.md#program.no-cycles)
- Reported at: the last of the `use` declarations and paths through which the modules of the cycle depend on one another (errors.several-places). A path is placed at its first name.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0206_import_cycle`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0206_import_cycle):

`customers.lt`:

```stilt fragment
use orders

pub fn name() -> str { "Ada" }
```

`main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
use orders

fn main() {}
```

`orders.lt`:

```stilt fragment
use customers

pub fn total() -> i64 { 0 }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── IMPORT CYCLE ───────────────────────────────────────── orders.lt:1:1  [E0206]

Modules depend on one another in a cycle: orders -> customers -> orders:

  1 │ use customers
    │ ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

Modules can't import one another in a cycle. Move what both need into a third
module, which each imports.
```
